content: Melvin-Koushki reports that the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam is referenced in Ibn Turka's own R. Ḥurūf, which he dates to completion in Ramaḍān 817/November 1414, and describes the work as a long and subtle commentary on Ibn ʿArabī's masterpiece featuring frequent lettrist explanations and excursuses.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam; R. Ḥurūf
